title: Programmed movement & reveal
rule: Travel only the resolved path, ending at the authoritative tile and facing; reveal conveys the real register.

ideas.title: Floor receipt
ideas.action: Robot grips a receipt printed from its own chest and reels itself along it; the paper tears precisely at the destination tile.

ideas.title: Feet arrive first
ideas.action: Detachable feet scuttle to the next legal tile, stop expectantly, then the chassis concertinas forward to catch them.

ideas.title: Shelf-label flipbook
ideas.action: Each traversed tile flips like a shelf price label, carrying a successive pose of the robot until the real chassis steps out at the end.

ideas.title: Register jack-in-a-box
ideas.action: The revealed movement card opens as a tiny loading ramp; the robot rolls off it and follows only the programmed path.

ideas.title: Cart wheel conspiracy
ideas.action: Three wheels politely align while one stubborn caster points elsewhere; all snap straight together and deliver the exact commanded distance.

ideas.title: Suction steps
ideas.action: Two suction cups alternately stick and release along the resolved path.

ideas.title: Invisible shopping cart
ideas.action: Robot mimes pushing a cart; its belly follows the imaginary handle between legal tiles.

ideas.title: Drawstring stride

ideas.title: Stapler walk

ideas.title: Aisle roller skate
ideas.action: One oversized skate unfolds under both feet and retracts on arrival.

ideas.title: Moving walkway rug
ideas.action: Robot unrolls a tiny rug beneath itself and rolls it up behind.

ideas.title: Elbow crawl
ideas.action: Arms become temporary forelegs while the wheels pretend to steer.

ideas.title: Vacuum recoil
ideas.action: A dust puff exits behind, propelling a cosmetic lean along the legal path.

ideas.title: Tape dispenser shoes
ideas.action: Shoes lay transparent tape, then peel themselves free at the destination.

ideas.title: Counterweight commute
ideas.action: A head counterweight swings ahead and pulls the chassis after it.

ideas.title: Pallet-jack lift
ideas.action: The robot lifts its own feet with tiny forks and rolls the exact distance.

ideas.title: Secret heel wheels
ideas.action: Feet rotate to reveal wheel heels for one movement beat.

ideas.title: Folded hallway

ideas.title: Binocular feet

ideas.title: Late antenna

ideas.title: Automatic doors
ideas.action: Two tiny doors slide open on its chest, revealing running legs that propel it.

ideas.title: Dust bunny escort
ideas.action: A dust bunny races just ahead and gets vacuumed up at the legal endpoint.

ideas.title: Crab disguise

ideas.title: Shelf bracket stride

ideas.title: Rolling inventory stamp

ideas.title: Hinge bridge
ideas.action: A hinged shin spans the next square and pulls the body across.

ideas.title: Shoe exchange
ideas.action: Feet trade positions with a quick flourish while the body travels straight.

ideas.title: Pneumatic hiccup
ideas.action: Small piston hiccups move the body in pulses, ending exactly on time.

ideas.title: Card runway
ideas.action: The active command stretches into a runway, then retracts after the resolved move.

ideas.title: Headlight tug
ideas.action: Its headlight beam appears to pull the nose forward like a leash.

ideas.title: Spring staircase
ideas.action: A spring under the belly rises and lowers while the base follows the legal path.

ideas.title: Shopping-bag sail
ideas.action: A crumpled bag catches imaginary wind behind the moving robot, then folds into its pocket.

ideas.title: Drawer legs
ideas.action: Legs slide from body drawers, take the next square, and close the drawers behind.

ideas.title: Tidy skid
ideas.action: A small mop emerges behind the robot to erase its cosmetic tire marks.

ideas.title: Zipper travel
ideas.action: A floor zipper opens beneath the advancing base and closes immediately behind.

ideas.title: Clockwork caterpillar
ideas.action: Segmented lower panels ripple in sequence while the body advances.

ideas.title: Antenna fishing rod
ideas.action: Antenna casts a harmless line to the destination and reels the chassis toward it.

ideas.title: Escaping price sticker
ideas.action: A sticker stuck to the foot stretches behind, releases, and lands on the chest.

ideas.title: Patient head
ideas.action: The head holds steady in world space for a beat while the body walks underneath, then catches up.

ideas.title: Wheel audition
ideas.action: Several tiny wheels pop out, one takes the load, and the others politely retreat.

ideas.title: Trolley pole vault
ideas.action: A short pole plants inside the next tile, tilts the body across, and folds away.

ideas.title: Program ticket rip
ideas.action: A ticket with the true movement count tears one notch per traversed square.

ideas.title: Stock picker
ideas.action: Robot extends a little ladder forward and climbs its own ladder horizontally.

ideas.title: Shelf dust reveal
ideas.action: A movement card wipes dust from its face before exposing the actual command.

ideas.title: Register nesting tray
ideas.action: The chosen register rises from nested trays, carrying the actual card into view.

ideas.title: Command periscope
ideas.action: The real card peeks above the robot through a periscope frame before execution.

ideas.title: Instruction ironing
ideas.action: A crumpled actual command card passes through a tiny iron and emerges readable.

ideas.title: Five-slot marquee

ideas.title: Card turnstile
ideas.action: The revealed card rotates through a checkout turnstile and locks face-up.

ideas.title: Receipt cursor
ideas.action: A punched hole travels across the actual command's movement symbols in sync with legal steps.

title: Programmed turning
rule: End at the same tile with exactly the commanded orientation.

ideas.title: Head files a request
ideas.action: Head rotates first, taps the unresponsive body, then the chassis reluctantly swivels to the same legal facing.

ideas.title: Price-gun pivot
ideas.action: A tiny price gun anchors to the floor and retracts its label tape, pulling the body around the tile center.

ideas.title: Unscrew and reseat
ideas.action: The robot lifts like a screw turning out of its base, rotates the commanded amount, and drops back into its threads.

ideas.title: Aisle sign betrayal
ideas.action: An overhead aisle arrow rotates the correct way; the robot stares, rotates to obey, and the sign folds into its head.

ideas.title: One-foot compass
ideas.action: One foot pins the tile center while the other draws a quarter-circle squeak; the torso overshoots cosmetically and settles to the exact facing.

ideas.title: Wheel argument
ideas.action: Left and right wheels point at each other, then coordinate the commanded pivot.

ideas.title: Coat-hanger swivel
ideas.action: The shoulders hang from an imaginary hook while the feet rotate underneath.

ideas.title: Head screw cap

ideas.title: Compass needle

ideas.title: Rotary phone dial

ideas.title: Fold-out outrigger

ideas.title: Sideways blink
ideas.action: Eye shutters close diagonally and open aligned with the new direction.

ideas.title: Shelf-label hinge
ideas.action: The body flips sideways like a shelf tag, settling at the requested orientation.

ideas.title: Umbrella crank
ideas.action: A tiny crank above the head winds the body around its center.

ideas.title: Delayed backpack
ideas.action: The front turns first; a backpack swings around afterward and clicks home.

ideas.title: Reverse necktie
ideas.action: A hanging cable swings past the chest and pulls the shoulders into the turn.

ideas.title: Miniature revolving door
ideas.action: A transparent revolving door briefly surrounds the robot and rotates it in place.

ideas.title: Pan handle
ideas.action: A handle extends from the base; a robotic wrist turns it like a frying pan.

ideas.title: Wrench collar
ideas.action: A loose wrench catches the neck collar and pulls the head and body through the turn.

ideas.title: Ball-bearing shuffle
ideas.action: Feet become ball bearings, scatter within the tile, then reform under the new facing.

ideas.title: Quarter coin
ideas.action: A floor coin tips upright, turns the chassis, and lies flat again.

ideas.title: Sprinkler hesitation
ideas.action: The torso makes two tiny anticipatory clicks before the exact final pivot.

ideas.title: Drawer corner

ideas.title: Helicopter eyebrows
ideas.action: Eyebrows spin briefly while the chassis makes only the legal turn.

ideas.title: Brake and swing

ideas.title: Cardboard hinge
ideas.action: A crease appears down the robot, folding the visible front toward the new facing.

ideas.title: Aisle mirror
ideas.action: A tiny mirror rotates to show the desired front; the robot copies it.

ideas.title: Compass chalk
ideas.action: A foot marks the true turn arc, then erases it with its heel.

ideas.title: Socket rotation
ideas.action: The base lifts a fraction from a keyed socket, rotates, and reseats.

ideas.title: Periscope first
ideas.action: The head becomes a periscope, looks toward the new direction, and pulls the body after it.

ideas.title: Cord unwinding
ideas.action: A coiled waist cable unwinds exactly the requested quarter or half turn.

ideas.title: Shopping trolley spin
ideas.action: Only the cosmetic upper basket sways after the legal pivot has completed.

ideas.title: Pocket turntable
ideas.action: The robot places a miniature turntable beneath itself, uses it, then pockets it.

ideas.title: Half-fold salute
ideas.action: An arm salutes the new direction while the chassis turns under the held pose.

ideas.title: Chassis page turn
ideas.action: The robot's front peels like a book page to reveal its new-facing silhouette.

ideas.title: Gimbal wobble
ideas.action: The head remains level while the body pivots with a tiny gyroscope wobble.

ideas.title: Toaster lever
ideas.action: A side lever drops, the torso turns, and the lever springs back up.

ideas.title: Cable lassoo
ideas.action: A loose cable circles the body once but only tugs the exact commanded rotation.

ideas.title: Heel squeal
ideas.action: A rubber heel stretches sideways, snaps free, and carries the pivot to its endpoint.

ideas.title: Reversed faceplate
ideas.action: A second faceplate peeks from the side, then the entire robot aligns behind it.

ideas.title: Bubble-level check
ideas.action: A tiny spirit level appears after turning and approves the exact alignment.

ideas.title: Elbow indicator
ideas.action: A semaphore elbow points into the turn, then retracts when facing is correct.

ideas.title: Tangent wheels
ideas.action: All wheels briefly align tangentially around the center and rotate the body smoothly.

ideas.title: Rolling pin shoulders
ideas.action: Shoulders roll sideways across the torso while the base turns beneath them.

ideas.title: Shelf bookend
ideas.action: A folding bookend nudges the side of the robot around its center.

ideas.title: Antenna weather vane
ideas.action: The antenna swings to the commanded heading and stiffens as the body catches up.

ideas.title: Lazy elbow
ideas.action: The robot rests one elbow on its own rotating base while turning.

ideas.title: Corkscrew shadow
ideas.action: Only the shadow curls dramatically while the body makes the exact plain turn.

ideas.title: Turn instruction peel
ideas.action: A curved-arrow sticker peels from the command card and wraps around the base.

ideas.title: Perfectly late click
ideas.action: The body completes the turn, waits a beat, and one tiny alignment peg finally clicks in.

title: Single robot push
rule: Both robots follow the resolved push path; no extra displacement, rotation, or damage.

ideas.title: Courtesy handle
ideas.action: The target involuntarily unfolds a shopping-cart handle; the pusher takes it, escorts it one legal tile, and the handle snaps shut.

ideas.title: Accordion apology
ideas.action: Contact compresses the target into an accordion; its front unfolds to the destination and its rear catches up with an apologetic bow.

ideas.title: Static-cling handoff
ideas.action: The robots stick cheek to cheek at contact, peel apart with a stretched static silhouette, and land on their resolved tiles.

ideas.title: Casual lean
ideas.action: The pusher leans like a shopper waiting in line; the target slowly realizes it is moving and frantically carries its own feet forward.

ideas.title: Receipt of displacement
ideas.action: At contact the target prints a tiny receipt, checks the one-tile charge, then glides to the legally assigned square in offended dignity.

ideas.title: Polite suitcase
ideas.action: Target sprouts a handle and rolls like reluctant luggage for the legal displacement.

ideas.title: Foam bumper
ideas.action: Contact bumper swells between robots, then compresses as both settle to their resolved tiles.

ideas.title: Shoulder magnet
ideas.action: Two cosmetic shoulder magnets click together and release after the true shove.

ideas.title: Backpack conveyor
ideas.action: The target's backpack briefly becomes a belt that walks its feet along.

ideas.title: Rubber stamp contact
ideas.action: The pusher leaves a temporary arrow stamp on the target's back, then wipes it away.

ideas.title: Shared umbrella
ideas.action: A narrow canopy pops over both robots during the shove and folds at separation.

ideas.title: Foot relocation
ideas.action: Target lifts both feet in surprise while tiny emergency rollers carry it the legal distance.

ideas.title: Tiny valet
ideas.action: The pusher unfolds a valet glove that guides the target's shoulder.

ideas.title: Elastic bowtie
ideas.action: Target's bowtie stretches forward before its chassis follows the push.

ideas.title: Packing wedge

ideas.title: Borrowed shopping list

ideas.title: Sliding dinner tray
ideas.action: Target's feet turn into a tray sliding neatly onto the next tile.

ideas.title: Forward sneeze
ideas.action: Contact squeezes a small cosmetic sneeze from the target as it is displaced.

ideas.title: Backward glance
ideas.action: Target looks back only after moving, discovering the pusher already occupying the vacated space.

ideas.title: Rotating cheek panel
ideas.action: Contact spins a loose cheek panel while the robot's actual facing stays fixed.

ideas.title: Apology flag
ideas.action: Pusher raises a tiny apology pennant during the shove and accidentally tangles it in its antenna.

ideas.title: Paperclip coupling
ideas.action: A large paperclip briefly links the robots, flexes, then springs off harmlessly.

ideas.title: Travel-sized wheels

ideas.title: Instant forklift

ideas.title: Rubber duck bumper

ideas.title: Inventory handover
ideas.action: A clipboard passes from target to pusher during the move, then returns with an arrow drawn on it.

ideas.title: Coat-tail tug
ideas.action: Target's back panel stretches like a coat tail and snaps flush when movement ends.

ideas.title: Tea remains level
ideas.action: Target produces a tiny cup that stays perfectly level through its body wobble.

ideas.title: Reverse moonwalk
ideas.action: Target's feet walk against the push while its base still follows the authoritative path.

ideas.title: Floor polishing
ideas.action: A mop deploys under the target, making the legal slide look suspiciously effortless.

ideas.title: Pusher overcommits
ideas.action: Pusher's arms continue reaching after bodies stop, then slowly retract.

ideas.title: Social distance ruler
ideas.action: A tiny ruler extends between noses, compresses during contact, and folds away after separation.

ideas.title: Side mirror surprise
ideas.action: Target's rearview mirror spots the pusher one beat too late.

ideas.title: Packaging squeak
ideas.action: Target's shell wrinkles like clear packaging at contact and smooths while sliding.

ideas.title: Handle pops wrong side
ideas.action: A target handle appears on its front; pusher reaches around cosmetically while both move legally.

ideas.title: Spring-loaded knees
ideas.action: The target's knees fold backward in shock and recover over the exact displacement.

ideas.title: Velcro shoulders

ideas.title: Label transfer

ideas.title: Personal turnstile

ideas.title: Puddle of feet

ideas.title: Pocket handrail

ideas.title: Trolley chain release

ideas.title: Belly piston
ideas.action: The pusher's belly piston extends into contact and retracts as the move finishes.

ideas.title: Shoulder seesaw
ideas.action: Target's shoulders tilt in opposite directions, passing a wobble through its body.

ideas.title: Dust line negotiation

ideas.title: Tiny moving notice

ideas.title: Foot brakes too late
ideas.action: Two heel brakes spark cosmetically only after arrival, then sheepishly lift.

ideas.title: Passenger seat
ideas.action: Target briefly folds into a seated posture while gliding, then stands at its legal endpoint.

ideas.title: Contact handshake

ideas.title: Late hats

ideas.title: Accordion train

ideas.title: Shelf book row

ideas.title: Cable knitting

ideas.title: Many-handed courtesy

ideas.title: Receipt relay

ideas.title: Belly pistons

ideas.title: Domino faces

ideas.title: End robot conductor

ideas.title: Trolley coin chain

ideas.title: Nested antennae

ideas.title: Sequential bowties

ideas.title: Inventory wave

ideas.title: Shoulder staircase
ideas.action: Shoulders lift in a traveling staircase pattern while feet stay grounded.

ideas.title: Push paperwork

ideas.title: Caterpillar skirt

ideas.title: Floor tape train

ideas.title: Waiting room seats

ideas.title: Collective eyebrow

ideas.title: Telescopic handles

ideas.title: Mop brigade

ideas.title: Shoelace loop

ideas.title: Queue number mistake

ideas.title: Compressed shopping bags
ideas.action: Paper-bag silhouettes crumple between bodies and puff open as they separate.

ideas.title: Wobble echo

ideas.title: Doorbell unanswered

ideas.title: Suction nose

ideas.title: Folded bumper

ideas.title: Tiny argument

ideas.title: Shelf bracket catch

ideas.title: Loose drawer spill

ideas.title: Hinge forehead

ideas.title: Pulse climbs antenna
ideas.action: Light runs up the antenna and back down into the core like a completed circuit.

ideas.title: Core warms hands
ideas.action: The robot holds its hands around the brightening core for a moment of satisfaction.

ideas.title: Geometric gulp
ideas.action: A small chest aperture widens, swallows the charge, and closes neatly.

ideas.title: Energy scales
ideas.action: Two tiny internal pans balance as the actual energy count updates.

ideas.title: Light spring compression
ideas.action: The pickup compresses a luminous spring inside the chest that locks at the real count.

ideas.title: Glass petal capture
ideas.action: Chest petals open around the incoming charge and fold back into the shell.

ideas.title: Foot tap approval
ideas.action: After the real gain, one foot gives a tiny pleased tap in place.

ideas.title: Core polishing
ideas.action: The pickup wipes a dull band from the core, revealing its incremented energy segments.

ideas.title: Antenna tuning glow
ideas.action: Antenna rotates slightly until the charge locks into the core.

ideas.title: Nested battery sleeve
ideas.action: A sleeve slides over the core, compresses the incoming light, and retracts.

ideas.title: Light spoon
ideas.action: A tiny spoon feeds the charge to a chest aperture, then folds into the wrist.

ideas.title: Energy pearl
ideas.action: The pickup forms a pearl that sinks through the transparent shell into the core.

ideas.title: Shoulder lamps count
ideas.action: Small shoulder lamps light only as many pulses as units actually gained.

ideas.title: Core takes a breath
ideas.action: The core expands on intake, then exhales a soft contained glow.

ideas.title: Glass funnel hand
ideas.action: The hand becomes a funnel guiding the real pickup into the chest.

ideas.title: Charge knot unties
ideas.action: A luminous knot loosens into a straight line feeding the core.

ideas.title: Internal elevator delivery
ideas.action: A tiny platform carries the energy bead from feet to chest behind clear panels.

ideas.title: Eye follows snack
ideas.action: The eye follows the charge all the way into the body, then looks forward again.

ideas.title: Light hinge boost
ideas.action: Small joint lights brighten in sequence after the actual energy increment.

ideas.title: Core balances new bead
ideas.action: The core briefly juggles the incoming bead before absorbing it.

ideas.title: Charging collar
ideas.action: A ring rises from the tile to the chest, deposits the charge, and collapses inward.

ideas.title: Battery window wipe
ideas.action: A small wiper clears the energy display to reveal the correct updated value.

ideas.title: Contented shell stretch
ideas.action: The shell stretches upward slightly after charging, then returns to its normal dimensions.

ideas.title: Overflow courtesy
ideas.action: At the energy cap, the intake closes politely and no additional charge enters.

ideas.title: Counted spark ladder
ideas.action: Exactly one rung per gained energy unit lights inside the chassis, then becomes the display.

ideas.title: Quiet satisfied blink
ideas.action: The core updates first; the eye gives one slow satisfied blink afterward.

title: Checkpoints
rule: Credit only the next required checkpoint, showing the actual new checkpoint count.

ideas.title: Time-clock punch
ideas.action: Checkpoint punches a tiny timecard protruding from the robot; the new hole becomes the actual checkpoint numeral before the card retracts.

ideas.title: Velvet rope approval
ideas.action: A miniature velvet rope opens ceremoniously around the robot, gets tangled for one beat, and snaps into a clean ring with the earned number.

ideas.title: Shelf stamp
ideas.action: A giant stock stamp descends, stops just above the robot's head, and stamps only its shadow with the earned checkpoint number.

ideas.title: Receipt crown
ideas.action: A receipt prints from the checkpoint, folds itself into a small numbered crown on the robot, then packs into a badge.

ideas.title: Security gate courtesy
ideas.action: Two tiny security gates scan the robot, almost beep, then bow outward while the earned checkpoint number clicks into place.

ideas.title: Light fingerprint
ideas.action: The checkpoint reads the robot's palm and lights only the newly earned checkpoint number.

ideas.title: Glass arch nod
ideas.action: A clear arch dips toward the robot as the real checkpoint count advances.

ideas.title: Core badge
ideas.action: A small numbered light badge forms inside the chassis at the moment of valid credit.

ideas.title: Eye recognition
ideas.action: The checkpoint's tiny eye and the robot's eye blink in sequence before the number updates.

ideas.title: Holographic handshake
ideas.action: A light hand rises from the tile, congratulates the robot, and dissolves into the earned numeral.

ideas.title: Floor ring locks
ideas.action: A segmented ring around the tile closes one actual checkpoint segment and fades.

ideas.title: Glass stamp shadow
ideas.action: A transparent stamp touches only the robot's shadow, leaving the correct number briefly visible.

ideas.title: Antenna pennant
ideas.action: A tiny numbered pennant grows from the antenna and folds into a small badge.

ideas.title: Checkpoint aperture
ideas.action: An iris opens beneath the robot, scans upward, and closes with the new count.

ideas.title: Core and beacon duet
ideas.action: The robot core and checkpoint beacon pulse once together on valid arrival.

ideas.title: Light ribbon measure
ideas.action: A ribbon measures the robot's height, then folds into the earned checkpoint numeral.

ideas.title: Glass pedestal nod
ideas.action: A shallow pedestal rises a fraction under the stationary robot and settles again.

ideas.title: Eye wears medal
ideas.action: A small numbered ring frames the eye briefly before sliding onto the chest.

ideas.title: Footprint signature
ideas.action: The robot's footprints glow as a signature, then merge into the checkpoint count.

ideas.title: Tiny official
ideas.action: A small geometric official emerges from the beacon, nods, and folds away.

ideas.title: Checkpoint lens focus
ideas.action: A lens focuses on the robot, clicks sharp, and reveals the actual earned number.

ideas.title: Light laurel hinge
ideas.action: Two abstract light branches hinge around the robot and close into a compact badge.

ideas.title: Glass bell recognition
ideas.action: A transparent bell shape expands once around the beacon without obscuring the board.

ideas.title: Progress notch
ideas.action: A visible notch clicks into the robot's checkpoint display, matching the true count.

ideas.title: Reflection congratulations
ideas.action: The robot's reflection gives a tiny bow while the body stays upright.

ideas.title: Beacon salutes
ideas.action: The checkpoint beacon tilts like a salute and returns to its neutral position.

ideas.title: Number unfolds
ideas.action: The earned numeral unfolds from a thin line into a readable three-dimensional shape.

ideas.title: Eye-to-beacon glance
ideas.action: Robot and beacon exchange a quick glance before the count updates.

ideas.title: Luminous seal
ideas.action: A circular seal forms on the chest, stamps the actual checkpoint number, and shrinks away.

ideas.title: Glass ticket slot
ideas.action: A small slot accepts a light token and returns the earned-number badge.

ideas.title: Checkpoint halo parking
ideas.action: A thin halo descends, pauses around the robot, and parks briefly behind its head.

ideas.title: Core staircase
ideas.action: A small internal staircase gains one step for the newly earned checkpoint.

ideas.title: Antenna height mark
ideas.action: A temporary height mark appears beside the antenna, then becomes the progress numeral.

ideas.title: Light clasp
ideas.action: Two halves of a badge clasp together on the chassis at valid checkpoint credit.

ideas.title: Floor tile applause
ideas.action: Four tiny tile-edge flaps lift in sequence and settle around the stationary robot.

ideas.title: Beacon opens flower
ideas.action: Geometric beacon petals open to reveal the earned number, then fold closed.

ideas.title: Number orbit
ideas.action: The actual checkpoint numeral orbits the robot once and docks on its display.

ideas.title: Tiny velvet-light gate
ideas.action: Two light posts bow apart around the robot without moving its base.

ideas.title: Core receives stamp
ideas.action: A stamp reaches through the transparent shell cosmetically and marks the internal progress display.

ideas.title: Glass ribbon curl
ideas.action: A narrow ribbon curls into the exact earned numeral above the tile.

ideas.title: Eye pupil star
ideas.action: The pupil briefly becomes an abstract many-point shape, then returns to its normal circle.

ideas.title: Checkpoint handoff
ideas.action: The beacon passes a small light block to the robot, which slots it into its progress display.

ideas.title: Floor reflection number
ideas.action: The earned numeral appears in the floor reflection before rising to the normal display.

ideas.title: Antenna flag check
ideas.action: The antenna bends toward the checkpoint beacon, touches light to light, and straightens.

ideas.title: Measured nod
ideas.action: The robot nods once while the checkpoint count clicks to the authoritative value.

ideas.title: Glass seal peel
ideas.action: A clear seal peels from the beacon and adheres briefly to the chassis.

ideas.title: Progress rail
ideas.action: A small marker advances one real notch on a short rail inside the robot.

ideas.title: Checkpoint wink through glass
ideas.action: The beacon light refracts through the robot and resolves into the earned number.

ideas.title: Wrong-order courtesy
ideas.action: At a non-next checkpoint, the beacon gives a small neutral nod but awards no number or progress.

ideas.title: Final checkpoint transition
ideas.action: The final valid checkpoint numeral locks first, then hands the visual emphasis to the actual winner celebration.

title: SPAM, Haywire & card replacement
rule: Show the real damage cards or replacement; only the resolved card changes gameplay.

ideas.title: Junk-mail slot
ideas.action: SPAM envelopes force themselves into the robot's mail slot; it posts them back out, but a conveyor quietly returns the same counted envelopes to its deck.

ideas.title: Misfiled instruction
ideas.action: The real replacement card crawls from a filing drawer, kicks out the SPAM card, and squares itself inside the active register.

ideas.title: Haywire marionette
ideas.action: A visible Haywire card briefly tugs the robot's cosmetic limbs with tangled strings; the strings straighten into the actual resolved command arrow.

ideas.title: Coupon avalanche
ideas.action: A tiny coupon curls out, then unfolds into an absurd accordion; it refolds into precisely the damage cards actually awarded.

ideas.title: Printer chews the program
ideas.action: The active card enters a jammed printer; rollers argue in opposite directions, then eject exactly the legal replacement face-up.

ideas.title: Crack finds the card
ideas.action: A luminous crack runs across the shell, turns a right angle, and becomes the border of the actual damage card.

ideas.title: Wrong reflection
ideas.action: The reflection obeys a different instruction for one beat; the robot pins it beneath the real Haywire card.

ideas.title: Dead pixel eviction
ideas.action: A dead pixel enlarges on the eye, is plucked out, and unfolds into one counted SPAM card.

ideas.title: Glass splinter alphabet
ideas.action: Harmless light splinters hover inside the shell, align into the actual card symbol, and slide into its assigned slot.

ideas.title: Card has gravity
ideas.action: A damage card dents the robot's light pool like a heavy object; the pool springs flat when the card enters the deck.

ideas.title: Misaligned transparency
ideas.action: The robot's translucent layers slip sideways like bad color registration, then align around the replacement card.

ideas.title: Instruction grows roots
ideas.action: The Haywire card grows fine luminous roots into a register slot; they retract into its resolved command symbol.

ideas.title: Eye tries to read sideways
ideas.action: A damage card rotates away whenever the eye tilts toward it, finally surrendering flat inside its real destination slot.

ideas.title: Unwanted bookmark
ideas.action: A thin SPAM strip worms between the deck's glass pages and proudly pops up as a bookmark.

ideas.title: Static comb
ideas.action: A comb passes through the eye's static and gathers it into precisely the damage cards awarded.

ideas.title: Bent command shadow
ideas.action: The outgoing command's shadow bends into the replacement symbol before the actual card flips to match it.

ideas.title: Paperweight reversal
ideas.action: The robot puts a glass weight on SPAM; the card lifts the weight and crawls into the discard anyway.

ideas.title: Broken subtitle
ideas.action: A luminous command glyph loses a stroke; the lost stroke pulls a replacement card into the register.

ideas.title: Card-shaped sneeze
ideas.action: The robot's eye contracts, expands, and expels a flat SPAM rectangle directly into its actual deck destination.

ideas.title: Error zipper
ideas.action: A zipper of light opens down the shell, reveals the damage card, then closes behind it without opening the body physically.

ideas.title: Interference knot
ideas.action: Two command traces knot together; the legal replacement slips through the knot and pulls it straight.

ideas.title: Bad card walks uphill
ideas.action: SPAM climbs the curved shell against gravity, pauses at the eye, and drops into the waiting discard slot.

ideas.title: Face-down magnet
ideas.action: The Haywire card keeps flipping face-down under an invisible magnetic pull until its correct reveal moment.

ideas.title: Fault line filing
ideas.action: A fault line divides the light pool into index tabs; the actual damage cards sink into their proper tabs.

ideas.title: Borrowed eye
ideas.action: The damage card briefly borrows the robot's eye to inspect its own symbol, then hands the light back.

ideas.title: One stubborn corner
ideas.action: Three corners of the damage card enter its slot; the fourth resists until the robot gently folds it in.

ideas.title: Command molt
ideas.action: The old command peels away like a transparent skin, revealing the actual replacement beneath.

ideas.title: Glass tick
ideas.action: A tiny tick of light runs around the body and stops on a damage card, becoming its corner mark.

ideas.title: Unread stack
ideas.action: One SPAM card makes its own reflection look like a huge stack; the reflection collapses to the true count.

ideas.title: Electrostatic fur
ideas.action: Fine light filaments stand upright on the shell, then sweep flat into the real Haywire card's pattern.

ideas.title: Slot hiccup
ideas.action: The register slot swallows the replacement halfway, hiccups it out, and neatly accepts it on the second attempt.

ideas.title: Wrong-size instruction
ideas.action: The real replacement is temporarily too large for its slot; its border contracts while the command symbol holds its size.

ideas.title: Self-addressed envelope
ideas.action: SPAM draws a return route back to the robot, follows that route, and lands in its legal discard location.

ideas.title: Card between dimensions
ideas.action: The damage card arrives edge-on as a hairline, twists into view, and clicks into the correct stack.

ideas.title: Command tether
ideas.action: The outgoing card leaves a stretchy light tether; the replacement snaps it loose and takes the register.

ideas.title: Prism cough
ideas.action: A prism inside the shell separates the eye's light into three slabs that recombine as the actual damage card.

ideas.title: Deck burp
ideas.action: The discard stack bulges once as the damage card arrives, then settles with the new card visibly on top.

ideas.title: Haywire pendulum
ideas.action: A Haywire glyph swings inside a glass pendulum, nearly settles on a false direction, then locks to the resolved command.

ideas.title: Tiny inspection mirror
ideas.action: The robot checks behind itself with a mirror and discovers SPAM already waiting inside the reflection of its deck.

ideas.title: Instruction scab
ideas.action: A bright patch grows over the hit point, peels away intact, and becomes one actual damage card.

ideas.title: Slot grows teeth
ideas.action: The active register sprouts tiny glass teeth, chews away the old symbol, and opens around the legal replacement.

ideas.title: Light pool typo
ideas.action: The pool beneath the robot briefly spells the wrong command; the replacement card presses it into the correct symbol.

ideas.title: Folded interference
ideas.action: A strip of visual interference folds into a compact card, retaining the exact SPAM or Haywire identity received.

ideas.title: Card in the highlight
ideas.action: The shell's specular highlight stretches into a card silhouette, detaches, and joins the real damage pile.

ideas.title: Wrong-way roller
ideas.action: A tiny roller paints the replacement symbol backward, pauses, flips its transparent film, and seats the now-correct card.

ideas.title: Damage constellation
ideas.action: One light point per awarded card appears inside the shell; each point expands into its actual card and exits separately.

ideas.title: Stolen pause
ideas.action: The robot freezes cosmetically while a Haywire card strolls across its face and takes its assigned register position.

ideas.title: Overeager eraser
ideas.action: A glass eraser rubs the old command completely away, then retreats as the real replacement redraws itself.

ideas.title: Card sticks to the ceiling
ideas.action: SPAM clings to the inside top of the shell until the robot taps once and it drops into the discard chute.

ideas.title: Hollow instruction
ideas.action: The outgoing command becomes an empty glass mold; the replacement pours through and solidifies in its proper slot.

title: Shield & damage prevention
rule: Communicate blocked damage only when a real shield prevents it; the beam and board state remain authoritative.

ideas.title: Warranty umbrella
ideas.action: A warranty booklet unfolds into a tiny umbrella at the impact side; the laser beads on it and drains harmlessly into its spine.

ideas.title: Return-to-sender stamp
ideas.action: A shield plate stamps the incoming light RETURN, folds it into an envelope, and shreds it locally without creating a reflected attack.

ideas.title: Bubble-wrap armor
ideas.action: One clear packing bubble swells at the impact point, absorbs the pulse with a satisfying inward pop, and smooths back into the chassis.

ideas.title: Sliding service shutter
ideas.action: A service shutter drops over the robot a split second before impact; a CLOSED sign flips once and the shutter lifts immediately.

ideas.title: Laser lint roller
ideas.action: A little roller sweeps over the impact side and collects the beam as a bright sticky stripe; the used sheet peels off and evaporates.

ideas.title: Light knot
ideas.action: The shield ties the incoming beam into a small knot, tightens it to a point, and extinguishes it locally.

ideas.title: Pocket eclipse
ideas.action: A dark glass disk slides across the impact point like a miniature eclipse and absorbs the pulse behind its rim.

ideas.title: Beam gets laminated
ideas.action: Two transparent shield sheets close around the laser, flatten it, and retract the harmless strip into the shell.

ideas.title: Unwelcome guest
ideas.action: A tiny shield door opens, sees the beam, immediately closes, and leaves the pulse crumpled against the exterior.

ideas.title: Glass gill
ideas.action: A row of gills opens at impact; the light passes into them and fades without emerging elsewhere.

ideas.title: Light swallowed sideways
ideas.action: The shield twists the beam flat against its own surface and rolls it into a bright bead that disappears.

ideas.title: Polite napkin
ideas.action: A thin plane of shield light dabs the incoming pulse once, folds itself neatly, and vanishes beside the robot.

ideas.title: Door chain
ideas.action: The shield opens a crack on a short chain, admits one glimpse of the beam, and slams shut before contact.

ideas.title: Accordion brake
ideas.action: The shield compresses the beam into closely spaced light folds, then closes the folds until no pulse remains.

ideas.title: Optical cork
ideas.action: A small glass cork grows into the impact point; the beam stops against it and the cork pops inward harmlessly.

ideas.title: Beam under glass
ideas.action: A transparent bell jar drops over the impact, traps the red light, and darkens from the bottom up.

ideas.title: Light gets combed
ideas.action: Fine shield teeth separate the pulse into hair-thin strands and sweep every strand into a local collection groove.

ideas.title: Impact dimple
ideas.action: The shield forms an inward dimple around the pulse, turns the dimple inside out, and releases no returning beam.

ideas.title: Tiny blackout blind
ideas.action: A blackout blind snaps down only across the impact patch, bulges once, then rolls away empty.

ideas.title: Beam in a bottle
ideas.action: The incoming pulse narrows into a tiny shield bottle; its stopper seats and the trapped light gently goes out.

ideas.title: Stretched moment
ideas.action: The beam visibly slows within a thick glass shield layer, shortens from the tail, and disappears before reaching the body.

ideas.title: Local whirlpool
ideas.action: The shield surface rotates a coin-sized whirlpool that winds the beam inward without affecting the robot's orientation.

ideas.title: Light bite
ideas.action: A round notch opens in the shield and takes one clean bite out of the pulse, then closes without a mark.

ideas.title: Pulse gets ironed
ideas.action: A tiny shield plate sweeps across the red pulse, pressing it into a hairline that cools to darkness.

ideas.title: Two-pane argument
ideas.action: Two glass panes trade places rapidly at impact, trap the beam between them, then settle into one intact shield.

ideas.title: Beam zipper
ideas.action: A zipper closes along the incoming light from its endpoint backward, swallowing it into the shield seam.

ideas.title: Squeegee shield
ideas.action: A luminous squeegee clears the pulse off the shield surface into a little drain at the robot's own base.

ideas.title: One-way prism
ideas.action: A shield prism refracts the pulse through an impossibly long internal path until it fades entirely inside the glass.

ideas.title: Shield shrugs
ideas.action: The shield's impact-side shoulder rises, catches the pulse in a crease, and lowers after the red light dies.

ideas.title: Punch card defense
ideas.action: The pulse punches a bright dot into the shield; the dot slides into a harmless row of spent marks and fades.

ideas.title: Glass eyelid
ideas.action: A large translucent eyelid closes over the impact side, flutters at the pulse, then opens onto an undamaged shell.

ideas.title: Pulse gets weighed
ideas.action: A miniature shield balance receives the beam, tips with absurd heaviness, and empties its light into a local absorber.

ideas.title: Rubber-light dent
ideas.action: The shield stretches around the beam like elastic glass, holds a comic pause, and collapses inward after absorption.

ideas.title: Light folded into silence
ideas.action: The red pulse folds in half repeatedly against the shield until it becomes a tiny dark square.

ideas.title: Shield catches its reflection
ideas.action: The shield's reflection rises to meet the pulse, sandwiches it against the real surface, and sinks back empty.

ideas.title: Microscopic revolving door
ideas.action: A tiny revolving shield door takes the pulse into an opaque compartment and completes its turn without releasing it.

ideas.title: Local hourglass
ideas.action: The pulse becomes fine light grains inside a shield hourglass; the last grain extinguishes before the glass retracts.

ideas.title: Beam loses its edge
ideas.action: The sharp incoming line turns soft and rounded inside the shield, contracts into a dull sphere, and fades.

ideas.title: Shield stitches itself
ideas.action: The pulse appears to split the shield; two rows of light stitches instantly close around and consume the red seam.

ideas.title: Impact on mute
ideas.action: A shield dial turns one notch at impact; the beam's glow visibly reduces to zero while its endpoint stays fixed.

ideas.title: Glass sponge
ideas.action: A porous glass patch absorbs the pulse cell by cell, swells slightly, then drains back to clear.

ideas.title: Finger trap
ideas.action: Two shield loops catch the pulse; its apparent attempt to advance only tightens them until the light vanishes.

ideas.title: Beam tucked in
ideas.action: A thin shield flap folds over the arriving pulse like a blanket and smooths its last bright corner flat.

ideas.title: Small ceremonial lid
ideas.action: A delicate lid rises at the impact point, receives the pulse beneath it, and closes with exaggerated care.

ideas.title: Unthread the laser
ideas.action: The shield finds the pulse's loose end and unravels it into a short thread that retracts into the same impact point.

ideas.title: Light labyrinth
ideas.action: The pulse enters a visible maze inside the shield, takes a comically circuitous route, and fades at the dead end.

ideas.title: Shield checks the pulse
ideas.action: A tiny glass caliper closes around the incoming line, measures it, and squeezes it to zero width.

ideas.title: Impact becomes a crease
ideas.action: The pulse folds the shield slightly; the robot smooths the crease with one small stroke after the light is absorbed.

ideas.title: One-use glass scale
ideas.action: A single scale on the shield lifts, catches the pulse beneath it, cools dark, and slides back flush.

ideas.title: Light swallowed by its shadow
ideas.action: A tiny dark shadow grows from the pulse's endpoint, overtakes the red line locally, and disappears with it.

title: Upgrades & special effects
rule: Each study is cosmetic to its named legal upgrade: installation, EMP, swap, tractor, or displacement resolves exactly once.

ideas.title: Tool chooses the owner
ideas.action: An installed tool hops from its blister pack, tries several mounting points, then clicks onto the correct robot without altering its position.

ideas.title: EMP store-closing wave
ideas.action: For a legal EMP, a circular wave turns miniature OPEN signs to CLOSED in sequence and they reopen as the effect ends; affected robots match the real target set.

ideas.title: Swap changing rooms
ideas.action: For a legal swap, two fitting-room curtains spin around the affected robots and open with their positions exchanged, preserving their authoritative facings.

ideas.title: Tractor tape measure
ideas.action: For a legal tractor effect, a tape measure hooks the target's base and retracts only the resolved distance, then flicks its hook free.

ideas.title: Displacement drawer trick
ideas.action: For a legal displacement, the target folds into a shallow drawer that slides along the resolved path and opens at its exact new tile.

ideas.title: Highlight installation
ideas.action: For installation, the tool travels along the robot's specular highlight before peeling into solid form at its actual mounting point.

ideas.title: Glass grows a socket
ideas.action: For installation, the shell dimples into a precisely fitted socket; the new tool falls into it and the surface closes flush.

ideas.title: Tool assembles its shadow
ideas.action: For installation, the tool's shadow arrives first and lays out the parts; the real tool drops into the completed silhouette.

ideas.title: Magnetic hesitation
ideas.action: For installation, a tool snaps toward the wrong cosmetic socket, stops short, and rotates into the correct mount.

ideas.title: Inside-out fitting
ideas.action: For installation, the shell briefly turns transparent while the tool is threaded through it and locked on the exterior.

ideas.title: Tool wakes its owner
ideas.action: For installation, the tool gently taps the robot's eye twice before attaching; the robot remains on its tile throughout.

ideas.title: One missing fastener
ideas.action: For installation, the tool waits motionless while one tiny screw rolls around the shell and seats itself last.

ideas.title: Light grows hardware
ideas.action: For installation, a thin drawing of the tool extrudes outward from the shell and gains polished material one edge at a time.

ideas.title: Reflection test fit
ideas.action: For installation, a reflected tool tries the mounting position beneath the glass; the real tool then copies the successful fit.

ideas.title: EMP light comb
ideas.action: A legal EMP sweeps a comb of dim light through affected robots only, briefly aligning their eye glows before releasing them.

ideas.title: EMP skipped heartbeat
ideas.action: A legal EMP makes affected light pools miss one pulse in sequence; unaffected pools keep their normal rhythm.

ideas.title: EMP descending pane
ideas.action: A legal EMP appears as a transparent pane lowering through affected bodies and briefly separating their internal light layers.

ideas.title: EMP loose reflections
ideas.action: A legal EMP detaches affected robots' reflections by a few cosmetic pixels, then lets them settle directly beneath their owners.

ideas.title: EMP frozen ripple
ideas.action: A legal EMP freezes a spreading ring at each affected robot; the rings fracture into short dim arcs and disappear.

ideas.title: EMP eyelight dominoes
ideas.action: A legal EMP dims affected eye lights in priority order, then restores their visuals while the actual card effect remains authoritative.

ideas.title: EMP optical moire
ideas.action: A legal EMP passes two fine glass grids over affected robots, creating a moving interference patch that clears at the end.

ideas.title: EMP caught breath
ideas.action: A legal EMP makes affected shells compress their internal glow into one held point, then slowly release its cosmetic brightness.

ideas.title: EMP bent horizon
ideas.action: A legal EMP bends a thin reflected horizon around the affected robots only; it snaps straight without moving any base marker.

ideas.title: Swap reflections first
ideas.action: For a legal swap, the two reflections exchange positions beneath the glass; their robots follow into the resolved exchanged tiles.

ideas.title: Swap glass sleeves
ideas.action: For a legal swap, transparent sleeves close around both robots, cross as luminous outlines, and open on their exchanged positions.

ideas.title: Swap negative space
ideas.action: For a legal swap, each robot becomes a robot-shaped hole in light; the holes trade places and refill with the correct bodies.

ideas.title: Swap bookends
ideas.action: For a legal swap, two upright glass pages fold inward and reopen with the robots exchanged, facing markers restored exactly.

ideas.title: Swap sliding highlights
ideas.action: For a legal swap, the robots compress into their brightest highlights, slide to the opposite resolved positions, and expand again.

ideas.title: Swap nested outlines
ideas.action: For a legal swap, one robot's outline expands while the other's contracts; the two outlines invert and reveal exchanged bodies.

ideas.title: Swap eye rendezvous
ideas.action: For a legal swap, the eye lights meet between the robots, pass each other politely, and pull their bodies into the exchanged tiles.

ideas.title: Swap optical curtains
ideas.action: For a legal swap, refraction bands sweep across the two occupied tiles and reveal the opposite robot behind each band.

ideas.title: Swap compressed portraits
ideas.action: For a legal swap, each robot flattens into a thin glass portrait; the portraits exchange and regain depth at the legal endpoints.

ideas.title: Tractor elastic shadow
ideas.action: A legal tractor stretches the target's shadow toward the source, then lets the target catch up by exactly the resolved distance.

ideas.title: Tractor glass tendon
ideas.action: A legal tractor grows one transparent tendon between source and target; its shortening draws the target to the resolved tile.

ideas.title: Tractor folding ruler
ideas.action: A legal tractor unfolds a luminous jointed ruler to the target and refolds only the joints corresponding to the legal pull.

ideas.title: Tractor light vacuum
ideas.action: A legal tractor forms a narrow light funnel ending at the target's base; the target slides the resolved distance without changing facing.

ideas.title: Tractor reluctant reflection
ideas.action: A legal tractor pulls the target's reflection first; the body slides after it and both align at the actual endpoint.

ideas.title: Tractor zipper floor
ideas.action: A legal tractor closes a glowing floor seam toward the source, drawing the target along only its resolved path.

ideas.title: Tractor winding ring
ideas.action: A legal tractor coils a thin ring around the target's base and winds its connecting thread shorter by the allowed distance.

ideas.title: Tractor tilted light
ideas.action: A legal tractor tilts only the reflected light beneath the target, which slides uphill through that reflection to its resolved destination.

ideas.title: Tractor obedient handle
ideas.action: A legal tractor creates a glass handle on the target; an invisible pull straightens the handle and moves the base the exact legal distance.

ideas.title: Displacement glass sled
ideas.action: For legal displacement, a thin glass sled forms under the target, carries it along the resolved path, and melts into the destination tile.

ideas.title: Displacement sliding window
ideas.action: For legal displacement, the target appears inside a refracting window that slides to the resolved tile and becomes clear.

ideas.title: Displacement folded corridor
ideas.action: For legal displacement, a narrow light corridor folds like bellows along the actual path and opens around the target at its endpoint.

ideas.title: Displacement eye tow
ideas.action: For legal displacement, the eye light moves just ahead of the body like a tow point, leading it only to the resolved square.

ideas.title: Displacement split silhouette
ideas.action: For legal displacement, horizontal slices of the target slide with a slight visual delay, then align perfectly at the legal destination.

ideas.title: Displacement rolling lens
ideas.action: For legal displacement, a lens rolls along the resolved path with the target enclosed, then dissolves without extra movement.

ideas.title: Displacement glass envelope
ideas.action: For legal displacement, a transparent envelope closes around the target, skates along its actual path, and opens at the resolved tile.

ideas.title: Displacement light hinge
ideas.action: For legal displacement, the target's silhouette pivots through a luminous hinge while its base travels only along the resolved path.

ideas.title: Displacement reversed reflection
ideas.action: For legal displacement, the target briefly seems suspended beneath the glass, slides to the actual endpoint, and flips upright into its legal pose.

title: Shutdown & wake-up
rule: Robot stays on its tile; activity and damage cleanup follow the actual shutdown state and round timing.

ideas.title: Dust-cover bedtime
ideas.action: Robot pulls a fitted showroom dust cover over itself; its antenna pokes through, retracts, and a small breathing fold settles to stillness.

ideas.title: Closing the till
ideas.action: The robot's chest closes like a cash drawer, eyes flip to CLOSED, and its last little finger carefully pushes the drawer flush.

ideas.title: Self-folding chair
ideas.action: The robot folds into a compact chair-shaped rest pose on its tile; on legal wake-up, the chair unfolds and the head emerges last.

ideas.title: Maintenance sock
ideas.action: A knitted cable sleeve rolls up over the robot like a sock; a maintenance tag hangs from its antenna until the round allows wake-up.

ideas.title: Wind-down orchestra
ideas.action: Every cosmetic appendage stops on a different beat; the last tiny fan keeps spinning, notices the silence, and finally folds its blades.

ideas.title: Eye puts itself away
ideas.action: The eye light detaches, opens a tiny drawer in the shell, climbs inside, and closes the drawer from within.

ideas.title: Reflection takes the watch
ideas.action: The robot dims while its reflection stays alert for one extra beat, looks upward, and finally dims too.

ideas.title: Glass flower closes
ideas.action: The shell's polished facets fold inward like petals around the eye, leaving a compact inactive body on the same tile.

ideas.title: Light pool blanket
ideas.action: The robot lifts the edge of its own light pool, drapes it over the shell, and lets the glow settle to a dim outline.

ideas.title: Antenna bookmark
ideas.action: The antenna folds into a little bookmark between the shell's closing layers; only the facing marker stays visible.

ideas.title: One last indicator
ideas.action: All lights turn off except a tiny indicator that notices the darkness, hesitates, then gently clicks itself off.

ideas.title: Body becomes its case
ideas.action: The robot forms a fitted transparent carrying case from its own outer shell and settles neatly inside it.

ideas.title: Eye rolls downhill
ideas.action: The eye light slowly rolls down the shell's internal curve and comes to rest in a dim socket at the bottom.

ideas.title: Polish goes matte
ideas.action: A matte boundary sweeps over the polished body, leaving the inactive robot dark and quiet on its unchanged base ring.

ideas.title: Folded horizon
ideas.action: The shell's reflected horizon folds down like a closing laptop, covering the eye without moving the robot's base.

ideas.title: Tiny night watch
ideas.action: A miniature light eye checks left and right above the shell, returns to its socket, and shuts the last aperture.

ideas.title: Nested shell
ideas.action: Successively smaller shell sections telescope inward until the robot rests as a compact polished capsule.

ideas.title: Unplugged highlight
ideas.action: A tiny hand pulls the robot's specular highlight out like a plug; the highlight retracts and the eye dims.

ideas.title: Glass eyelash
ideas.action: One long luminous eyelash grows across the eye, curls around its glow, and closes it like a delicate latch.

ideas.title: Reflection tucks the robot in
ideas.action: The reflection reaches up with a thin light line and smooths the robot's outer glow into a sleeping contour.

ideas.title: Compressed hum
ideas.action: A visible vibration ring contracts from the body into a single steady point, which fades into the inactive marker.

ideas.title: Shell becomes a pebble
ideas.action: Every protruding cosmetic feature retracts until the robot is a plain smooth pebble, with its tile and facing still marked.

ideas.title: Slow-closing aperture
ideas.action: The eye's aperture closes almost completely, opens for one last suspicious glance, then closes fully.

ideas.title: Light folds its wings
ideas.action: Two thin planes of internal light fold against one another and vanish into the center of the shell.

ideas.title: Maintenance seam
ideas.action: A narrow seam opens around the shell, a cleaning light passes once through it, and the seam closes into an inactive body.

ideas.title: Sleep latch too high
ideas.action: A tiny arm reaches unsuccessfully for a top latch, extends one extra joint, and finally switches the robot off.

ideas.title: Eye in a pocket
ideas.action: A small pocket forms in the shell; the robot drops its eye light into it and pats the pocket closed.

ideas.title: Static drains downward
ideas.action: Fine internal static sinks like sediment through the clear shell, leaving a calm dark upper body.

ideas.title: Cooling glass
ideas.action: A warm edge glow retreats through the shell's seams until only a tiny inactive status point remains.

ideas.title: Patient little screw
ideas.action: A small light screw turns for several beats after everything else has stopped, then seats flush with the shell.

ideas.title: Light pool folds small
ideas.action: The decorative light pool folds inward around the fixed facing marker, leaving a tight quiet ring under the robot.

ideas.title: Internal elevator
ideas.action: The eye descends visibly inside the translucent shell as if taking a tiny elevator to the basement, then disappears.

ideas.title: Closing inspection hatch
ideas.action: An inspection hatch in the robot closes from the inside; one little light finger pulls back just before the final click.

ideas.title: Silhouette exhale
ideas.action: A faint duplicate silhouette expands once like an exhale, thins away, and leaves the stationary inactive body.

ideas.title: Mechanical sigh
ideas.action: The body's upper half settles a few cosmetic millimeters into its base, releases one soft ring of light, and stops.

ideas.title: Wake eye oversleeps
ideas.action: On legal wake-up, the shell brightens first while its eye remains shut; a tiny internal nudge finally opens the eye.

ideas.title: Wake from the reflection
ideas.action: On legal wake-up, the reflection lights first and sends a thin vertical pulse through the glass into the real body.

ideas.title: Wake zipper
ideas.action: On legal wake-up, a line of light unzips around the shell and releases the eye glow into its proper aperture.

ideas.title: Wake focus hunt
ideas.action: On legal wake-up, the eye opens as an unfocused glow, tries three lens depths, and locks sharply onto the board.

ideas.title: Wake borrowed sunlight
ideas.action: On legal wake-up, the robot collects a reflected ceiling highlight, folds it into the eye, and resumes its ready pose.

ideas.title: Wake spring remembers
ideas.action: On legal wake-up, a compressed internal light spring releases section by section until the shell regains its full ready height.

ideas.title: Wake check of limbs
ideas.action: On legal wake-up, cosmetic attachments emerge in the wrong order, politely yield to one another, and settle into place.

ideas.title: Wake crystal thaw
ideas.action: On legal wake-up, frosted-looking glass clears from the eye outward, revealing the familiar polished color underneath.

ideas.title: Wake reluctant cover
ideas.action: On legal wake-up, a transparent shell cover lifts, catches on one tiny projection, and slips free after a careful tilt.

ideas.title: Wake eye climbs home
ideas.action: On legal wake-up, a light dot climbs an internal spiral from the base and settles into the eye aperture.

ideas.title: Wake calibration blink
ideas.action: On legal wake-up, the eye briefly tests a square, triangle, and circle before choosing its normal single luminous point.

ideas.title: Cleanup into one curl
ideas.action: During actual shutdown cleanup, removed damage cards lose their symbols and curl into one thin light ribbon that retracts safely.

ideas.title: Damage dusting
ideas.action: During actual shutdown cleanup, a tiny brush sweeps only the removed damage cards from the shell into the correct discard destination.

ideas.title: Empty slots breathe
ideas.action: After actual cleanup, cleared damage slots expand once, release a dim glow, and close while the robot remains shut down.

ideas.title: Last light checks the lock
ideas.action: The final active light circles the closed shell once as if checking every seam, then settles into the inactive status mark.

title: Race victory
rule: Celebrate only the authoritative winner after the final required checkpoint; no apparent extra race movement.

ideas.title: Employee of the minute
ideas.action: A store portrait frame descends around the winner, struggles to fit its antenna, then expands as a tiny nameplate locks underneath.

ideas.title: Checkout total
ideas.action: A receipt taller than the robot unrolls, its long item list snaps shut into one enormous WINNER line, and the robot peeks around it.

ideas.title: Podium from stock
ideas.action: Three flat cartons fold beneath the stationary winner into a display plinth; the top carton opens into a crown-shaped backdrop.

ideas.title: Aisles take a bow
ideas.action: Nearby shelf labels and lamps hinge toward the winner in a synchronized bow; the robot awkwardly bows back a beat too late.

ideas.title: Tiny grand opening
ideas.action: A miniature ribbon stretches between the winner's hands; its scissors are absurdly small, but one snip unfurls a full-width victory banner behind it.

ideas.title: Reflection applauds first
ideas.action: The winner's reflection grows two little light hands and applauds; the robot looks down, embarrassed, before bowing in place.

ideas.title: Crown refuses the antenna
ideas.action: A delicate light crown descends, catches on the antenna, expands one notch, and finally settles around it.

ideas.title: Glass floor autograph
ideas.action: The winner's light pool traces its silhouette as a signature beneath the glass, then resolves into a clean victory seal.

ideas.title: Light keeps the pose
ideas.action: The winner attempts a modest bow, but a luminous outline preserves its heroic upright pose beside the real body.

ideas.title: Victory too large
ideas.action: A huge laurel outline appears around the tiny winner, notices the mismatch, and carefully contracts to fit.

ideas.title: Eye accepts the spotlight
ideas.action: A spotlight arrives slightly off-center; the winner nudges the light with its eye until the beam frames its stationary body.

ideas.title: Personal constellation
ideas.action: The winner's checkpoint marks rise into a small constellation overhead and connect into its recognizable silhouette.

ideas.title: Tiny trophy inside
ideas.action: The shell becomes briefly transparent, revealing a tiny version of the winner already holding a trophy inside.

ideas.title: Victory opens the ceiling
ideas.action: A narrow slit of warm light opens above the winner like a ceiling hatch and unfolds into a quiet crown-shaped canopy.

ideas.title: Modest podium
ideas.action: A glass podium rises a comically tiny amount beneath the winner, pauses, and adds just one more small step.

ideas.title: Applause in the glass
ideas.action: Pairs of light arcs beneath nearby glass tiles clap toward the stationary winner, then settle back into the floor.

ideas.title: Winner gets polished
ideas.action: A circular highlight buffs the winner's shell to an exaggerated mirror finish; the robot inspects its own dazzling reflection.

ideas.title: Laurel finds the front
ideas.action: A floating laurel circles the robot looking for its eye, then locks to the authoritative facing direction.

ideas.title: Victory silhouette peel
ideas.action: A gold outline peels from the winner's body, floats upright behind it, and becomes a commemorative glass plaque.

ideas.title: Crown of completed turns
ideas.action: Small abstract echoes of the race's turns assemble into a crown above the winner without replaying movement on the board.

ideas.title: One enormous blink
ideas.action: The winner's single eye widens in disbelief, reflects the final checkpoint, then returns to a tiny pleased glow.

ideas.title: Trophy tests its balance
ideas.action: A slender glass trophy appears on the winner's head, wobbles delicately, and is steadied by one tiny cosmetic hand.

ideas.title: Reflection grows tall
ideas.action: The winner remains small while its reflection becomes a towering heroic silhouette beneath the glass, then politely shrinks back.

ideas.title: Banner pulled from a dot
ideas.action: The final checkpoint's light point stretches into a narrow line, then opens into a broad victory banner behind the winner.

ideas.title: Victory lens
ideas.action: A transparent lens briefly magnifies only the winner's eye, revealing a tiny crown reflected there before drifting away.

ideas.title: The floor presents flowers
ideas.action: Thin stems of warm light rise within the glass around the winner and unfold into geometric blooms without covering its tile marker.

ideas.title: Award with a tiny bow
ideas.action: A glass medal lowers on a light ribbon; the ribbon ties an absurdly small bow and the robot leans forward to inspect it.

ideas.title: Victory echo waits
ideas.action: A faint victorious pose appears behind the robot; the real winner takes a beat to notice, then finally matches the pose.

ideas.title: Spotlight origami
ideas.action: The cone of light above the winner folds its own edges into a crown while the body stays still beneath it.

ideas.title: Last checkpoint handshake
ideas.action: A small light hand emerges from the final checkpoint, shakes the winner's temporary hand once, and retracts ceremoniously.

ideas.title: Podium reflection only
ideas.action: A grand podium forms entirely beneath the glass in the winner's reflection, while the actual robot stays on its legal tile.

ideas.title: Glass medal chooses a side
ideas.action: A medal rotates edge-on several times, finds the robot's front, and rests neatly below the luminous eye.

ideas.title: Winner refuses to brag
ideas.action: A giant crown grows overhead; the robot gently presses it down until it becomes a discreet little head ornament.

ideas.title: Victory aperture
ideas.action: Concentric glass apertures open around the winner like a camera preparing a portrait, then stop with one warm framing ring.

ideas.title: Light pool standing ovation
ideas.action: The winner's light pool rises as a thin vertical ring, tilts in a bow, and returns flat beneath its unchanged position.

ideas.title: Antenna conducts
ideas.action: The winner's antenna flicks once; nearby decorative light lines rise and settle in response like a tiny orchestra.

ideas.title: Crown made of shadows
ideas.action: The winner's surrounding shadows tilt upward into a crown silhouette while its colored shell remains softly lit.

ideas.title: A trophy too transparent
ideas.action: The winner reaches for an almost invisible glass trophy, misses once, and finds it when a warm highlight outlines the edges.

ideas.title: Victory glass ribbon
ideas.action: A rigid glass ribbon spirals once around the stationary winner, pauses impossibly unsupported, and resolves into a laurel.

ideas.title: Checkpoint lights take attendance
ideas.action: One light for each earned checkpoint lines up above the winner, nods in sequence, and merges into the final victory mark.

ideas.title: Private little celebration
ideas.action: Inside the translucent shell, a tiny mechanism waves a microscopic flag while the outer robot tries to remain dignified.

ideas.title: Victory frame breathes
ideas.action: A thin portrait frame around the winner expands with its excited cosmetic squash, then settles as the robot composes itself.

ideas.title: Winner signs with light
ideas.action: The eye traces a short luminous autograph in the air; the flourish unexpectedly becomes a small crown on the signature.

ideas.title: Glass applause ripple
ideas.action: A pair of broad light ripples approaches the winner from opposite sides, meets beneath it, and rises as one clean victory ring.

ideas.title: One tiny fanfare
ideas.action: A miniature trumpet shape grows from the winner's shell, inflates to ridiculous length, and folds back into a modest medal.

ideas.title: The highlight takes a bow
ideas.action: The winner holds still while its specular highlight detaches, bows to the room, and returns to its proper place.

ideas.title: Victory display rotates around you
ideas.action: A transparent award display turns around the stationary winner, presenting every side while its actual facing marker stays fixed.

ideas.title: Crown catches the last beam
ideas.action: A harmless decorative beam crosses above the winner, bends into a crown, and gently lowers around the polished shell.

ideas.title: Winner and reflection disagree
ideas.action: The reflection strikes an extravagant victory pose; the robot gestures for restraint and both settle into a small matching bow.

ideas.title: The room leans in
ideas.action: Decorative reflected ceiling lines converge toward the winner for one quiet beat, then open outward around a single victory seal.
